summary: Loads the VFX dynamic library with LoadLibraryA(LibFileName), stores the module handle in hLibModule, resolves five function entry points (VFXOpen, VFXClose, VFXZeroSet, VFXSetVideoMode, VFXGetTracking) via GetProcAddress and caches them in the 0x008AFC78 block. Returns 1 if the library fails to load, 4 if any required export is missing, otherwise calls VFXOpen() to initialize and returns 0. Called by DualSourceAcquireWithFallback (004F8AE0).

local_names.LibraryA: HMODULE returned by LoadLibraryA and stored into hLibModule

operations.description: Load the VFX library: LibraryA = LoadLibraryA(LibFileName) via the kernel32 import, then hLibModule = LibraryA.
Load-failure gate: if LibraryA is NULL, return 1 immediately.
Resolve the VFXOpen entry point: VFXOpen = GetProcAddress(hLibModule, ProcName).
Resolve the VFXClose entry point: VFXClose = GetProcAddress(hLibModule, aVfxclose).
Resolve the VFXZeroSet entry point: VFXZeroSet = GetProcAddress(hLibModule, aVfxzeroset).
Resolve the VFXSetVideoMode entry point: VFXSetVideoMode = GetProcAddress(hLibModule, aVfxsetvideomod).
Resolve the VFXGetTracking entry point: VFXGetTracking = GetProcAddress(hLibModule, aVfxgettracking).
Export-completeness gate: if any of VFXGetTracking, VFXOpen, VFXClose, VFXZeroSet, VFXSetVideoMode is NULL, return 4.
Initialize the module by calling the cached VFXOpen function pointer.
Return 0 on success (after VFXOpen), 1 on load failure, 4 on missing exports.
Invoked by DualSourceAcquireWithFallback (004F8AE0) as the acquisition path for the VFX module.

unresolved: The library filename (LibFileName) and the semantics of the five resolved entry points are external; the VFX module identity and its interfaces are not documented here.
The calling convention and signature of VFXOpen (and the other cached pointers) are not evidenced by this packet.
